name: 80-independent-review
body:
[80-independent-review] Independent review in background

Desired behavior
Delivery owner gets an independent implementation review; the brief lets the critic judge the source task itself.

Executable contract
1. Task cycle → its implementation-critic used. Outside the task skill → the installed implementation-critic launched in the background after changes and before finishing, always. A second duplicating critic over the same task cycle unnecessary.
2. Critic gets the task in general form, source requirements, neutral artifact paths. Task cycle → CRYSTAL/PLAN exact payload; outside → TASK: <absolute path> to a neutral brief with source instruction, sources, explicit scope. Criteria derived by the checker itself; lack of edit rights turns no defect into a pass. Role's actual contract followed.
3. All subagents always background. omo → current task schema, exact installed role name, the runtime's real background mechanism. Other environment → its real async mechanism. "you are critic" does not establish a custom role.
4. Result awaited before delivery is declared ready. Proven defects fixed within authority, affected evidence refreshed; workflow gate re-run after repairs.
5. Review/acceptance roles act within their permissions, repair or read-only. Leaf reviewer launches no checker for its own verdict; task worker returns the result to the owner, who owns the gate. Exact role unavailable → configuration blocker; ad-hoc review = separate help, never the native gate.

Tools and skills
Task/role read when they apply. Input file structure checked with real read/search/bash per the role contract, never an invented task_artifact_check. Native task dispatch + result retrieval per omo's actual schema, background launch. Installed role + a real completed run = only role-gate proof.

Links: 01-operating-principle, 72-project-sources-details, 73-tests-not-proof, 75-evidence-or-blocker.

Anti-patterns
Synchronous launch; own implementation defended, verdict suggested, ready "why this is right" list in the brief; self-review as independence; fake named role; pending as pass; recursive critic chain.
